text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This is as far as it goes, I suppose...
choice_data_list: ...I couldn't win a single one, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please don't pay it any mind. Even from an 
outsider's perspective, it was a terrible 
ordeal.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I couldn't win the plushie, 
but I was able to gain something just as 
precious.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have bore witness to your courage in 
confronting hardship to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If my spirit ever wavers in the face of 
hardship, I shall remember today and look 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
